trends.headline: Trump Releases UFO Files with Rollout of New “Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters” (PURSUE)
trends.summary: The Pentagon has released U.S. documents related to UFOs under its Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters (PURSUE).

trends.headline: Pentagon publishes online UFO photo collection in historic release
trends.summary: The Pentagon will begin releasing never-before-seen files containing UAPs on a dedicated website, the agency announced Friday.

trends.headline: ‘Men in black’ wiped pics of 300-foot UFO, ex-Marine suggests
trends.summary: Former Marine Michael Herrera said the memory card and battery of his camera disappeared before military officials coerced him into keeping quiet about what he’d seen.

trends.headline: New film 'S4: The Bob Lazar Story' renews controversial UFO claims
trends.summary: "S4: The Bob Lazar Story," narrated by Bob Lazar himself, recounts what he allegedly witnessed at S4, near Area 51.

trends.headline: Non-human tech programs in UFO files? Unlikely says Ross Coulthart
trends.summary: "I think there are going to be very limited releases of maybe more blurry videos, maybe some good videos," Coulthart said.

trends.headline: Government not sitting on space alien evidence, Obama reiterates
trends.summary: The former president emphasized there’s no way such a secret could stay confidential.

trends.headline: Bizarre, UFO-like halo of red light appears over small Italian town — for the second time in 3 years
trends.summary: An eerie new photo shows a giant red ring shining above Possagno, near the Italian Alps. The eye-catching image is almost identical to one taken in the same town in early 2023.

trends.headline: Watch eerie 'UFOs' and a solar 'cyclone' take shape in stunning new ESA video of the sun
trends.summary: An eerie new video from ESA's Solar Orbiter shows a towering 'cyclone' of plasma exhibiting behaviors never seen before on our sun.

trends.headline: Did people report seeing UFOs before the 20th century?
trends.summary: Are UFO sightings a 20th-century phenomena, or did people report seeing them earlier in history?

trends.headline: Earth from space: Bizarre 'pet cloud' reappears above its favorite spot in New Zealand
trends.summary: A recent satellite image captured the reemergence of a unique, UFO-like cloud, known as the "Taieri Pet," which appears above New Zealand's South Island when conditions are just right.

trends.headline: What's the best evidence we've found for alien life?
trends.summary: Don't expect an alien invasion anytime soon.
